|Woken, is this sentinel.<br>F-f-f-functional, is its shell.
|[[Second Sentinel]]
}}

The <b>Cogheart</b>, also referred to as <b>Cogwork Heart</b>,<ref>Prompt when using the Cogheart on the inert [[Second Sentinel]]: <i>"Insert Cogwork Heart?"</i></ref> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Cogheart is used to activate [[Second Sentinel]] in [[Cogwork Core]]. This is required to be able to partake in the <i>[[Final Audience]]</i> [[Wish]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Cogwork Core Map Clean Textless Cogheart.png!Location of Second Sentinel's body in Cogwork Core
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Cogwork Core 08.png!Second Sentinel encased in Cogwork Core
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Cogheart is fashioned from three Cogheart Pieces found throughout [[the Citadel]], in the following locations:

{| class="article-table" width="100%"
! Area
! Location
! Map
|-
! [[Choral Chambers]]
| To the west, connected to the tall room that leads to [[The Slab]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Cogheart Piece 01.png|center|200px]]
|-
! [[Whispering Vaults]]
| In a room below the entrance to [[The Stage]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Cogheart Piece 02.png|center|200px]]
|-
! [[Memorium]]
| To the east, in the room above the map room.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Cogheart Piece 03.png|center|200px]]
|}

In order to collect each Cogheart Piece, a memory puzzle must be solved by striking bells in the same order as they are played. Failing a round will only reset the current one. The solutions are as follows, from left to right:

{| class="article-table" align="center"
! colspan=2 | Choral Chambers
|-
| 
* 1 - 5 - 4 - 6
* 3 - 6 - 5 - 1 - 7
* 2 - 4 - 6 - 3 - 5 - 1
| [[File:Screenshot SS Cogheart Choral Chambers Numbered.png|right|200px]]
|-
! colspan=2 | Whispering Vaults
|-
| 
* 1 - 2 - 7 - 4
* 7 - 5 - 6 - 4 - 5
* 2 - 7 - 3 - 5 - 6 - 1
| [[File:Screenshot SS Cogheart Whispering Vaults Numbered.png|right|200px]]
|-
! colspan=2 | Memorium
|-
| 
(up - down)
* 7 - 2 - 4 - 6
* 4 - 2 - 1 - 4 - 3
* 1 - 5 - 6 - 2 - 7 - 3
| [[File:Screenshot SS Cogheart Memorium Numbered.png|right|200px]]
|}
